lines.t: Every month, India makes more than twenty-four billion UPI payments.
In 2024 alone, Indians lost over twenty-two thousand crore rupees to cyber fraud.
Most scams don't hack the system. They hack the person.

Fake police keep victims on a call until they transfer their savings. Fake prizes trick people into approving collect requests. SIM swaps hijack accounts, and mule accounts move the money within minutes.
Once a payment settles, it's almost impossible to get back. The only moment to stop a scam is during the payment.
So we built ZeroLag. Real-time AI that checks every UPI payment inside the transaction, on IBM LinuxONE.
Each payment is allowed, warned, or held, in milliseconds.
Account and device IDs are tokenised first, so the model never sees who you are. Fourteen behaviour signals compare the payment with normal patterns.
A gradient-boosted model scores the risk, a novelty detector catches the unknown, and every decision comes with its reasons.
And it runs on our IBM LinuxONE instance. s390x, machine type 9175, with the NNPA flag for the Telum two AI accelerator.
This is the ZeroLag console, live on the mainframe, deciding each payment in about four milliseconds.
Open a held payment, and you see the risk score, the exact reasons, and the customer's message, in English and Hindi.
पुलिस या बैंक कभी कॉल पर पैसे नहीं मांगते। कॉल काटें और 1930 पर संपर्क करें।
Let's test one. An eighty-five-year-old, on a call, sends ninety-five thousand rupees to a six-day-old account.
Held, in under five milliseconds, with the reasons.
Her usual grocery payment? Allowed instantly.
On a week of payments it had never seen, ZeroLag caught ninety-six percent of scams and ninety-eight percent of the money, touching fewer than four in a thousand genuine payments.
On LinuxONE it's three times faster than on our laptop. And age is never used, so older customers get equal protection.
Payments already live on IBM Z, so ZeroLag brings the AI to the data. Next: the Telum accelerator, Crypto Express keys, and Secure Execution.
ZeroLag. Stop the scam before the money moves.
Thank you.
